description: 3 exemplars + 2 near-misses + 1 counterexample. Authored 2026-10-09 when the settings-key retirement touched this skill. Exemplars go from an idea to a structured plan, including the German phrasing. Near-misses are the neighbours a plan feeds: writing the roadmap file itself, and tightening one ticket's acceptance criteria.
